1742-1978-3363-7170.notablePrerequisites: The One Ring has a burden counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
1742-1978-3363-7170.description:
Animate The One Ring using Living Brain.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and drawing a card for each burden counter on it.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The One Ring.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-2577-6763-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2438-2577-6763-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

539-728-3179-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-3179-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

728-1202-2464-3249.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1202-2464-3249.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-1202-2464-3249.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

2781-6626-6867-7183.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

129-1409-2079-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1409-3099-4289-7297.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

215-5614-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
215-5614-7175.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-2806-4146.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Murmuring Mystic
1618-2440-2806-4146.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Reality Strobe.
Reality Strobe triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Murmuring Mystic triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Reality Strobe.
Repeat.
1618-2440-2806-4146.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Murmuring Mystic. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4668-4934-5078.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
4668-4934-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4644-5295-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2173-4699-5073-5220.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2173-3944-5220-5931.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Funeral Room // Awakening Hall trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Funeral Room // Awakening Hall trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1545-4050-6742.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1545-4050-6742.description:
Cast Timeline Culler either from your hand or from your graveyard for its warp cost by paying {B} and 2 life.
When Timeline Culler enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain 2 life. 
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Timeline Culler, adding {B}.
Repeat.
1545-4050-6742.notes: If Timeline Culler is in your hand, you can instead cast it normally and then cast it via its warp cost on each other iteration. This adds {B} to the mana needed but removes the life requirement.

2908-3168-3682-5542.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying one mana.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Dream Stalker from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

411-1768-4103-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have cycled Yidaro at least three times this game.
411-1768-4103-4613.description:
Activate Yidaro's cycling ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding it.
Yidaro triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Yidaro enters the battlefield, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yidaro.
Resolve the Yidaro cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yidaro using Grinning Ignus's ability by paying {1} and returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

1-2275-5436-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-2275-5436-6282.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-877-1374-5910.description:
Cast Nameless Inversion from your graveyard, as it is a Knight card, by paying {1} due to Morophon.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Resolve Nameless Inversion, giving a creature +3/-3 until end of turn.
If the creature has toughness 0 or less, the creature dies as a state-based action.
Repeat as desired.

643-3057-5703.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have a way to give Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad vigilance.
643-3057-5703.description:
Give Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad vigilance by any method.
Declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling Bloodthirster from your graveyard with a memory counter on it as it is an Assassin due to Maskwood Nexus, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the Bloodthirster token.
The Bloodthirster token triggers, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling the Bloodthirster token.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.

1308-2043-3499-4131.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Basalt Monolith that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
Activate both Basalt Monolith tokens' first abilities by tapping them, adding six {C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-2557-3272-4231.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Immovable Rod and another artifact, untapping Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, causing you to venture into the Cave Entrance room of Lost Mine of Phandelver, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Immovable Rod and another artifact, untapping Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, causing you to venture into the Mine Tunnels room of Lost Mine of Phandelver, and create two Food, two Clue, and two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Immovable Rod and another artifact, untapping Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, causing you to venture into the Dark Pool room of Lost Mine of Phandelver, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Immovable Rod and another artifact, untapping Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, causing you to venture into the Temple of Dumathoin room of Lost Mine of Phandelver, causing you to draw a card and complete Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

372-4050-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other nonland permanents.
372-4050-5003.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Abdel Adrian, adding {1}.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing all cards exiled with it to return to the battlefield under their owner's control.
Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling four other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating four 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Soldiers, adding {3}.
Repeat.

430-1061-2045.notablePrerequisites:
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
You have the city's blessing.
430-1061-2045.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, From Beyond triggers, creating a copy of Timestream Navigator.
Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator, paying {2}{U}{U} and putting Timestream Navigator on the bottom of your library to take an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
